After installing the app, simply select the corresponding city product page from the link. View city products Instructions for use: To use the site, simply place the text or buttons from the [City Subsites] in their corresponding locations and add links to the city list pages. The category names on the city product pages and the titles within the lists have already been restructured—please don’t delete or modify them, as doing so could prevent cities from being properly displayed. Specific method for passing parameters: On the city product list page, within the loop for each city, select the application data source for that city’s product and create a parameter named "Pass City." Once set up, go to the city list page, choose the parameter you just created, and link it to a custom page—specifically, the city product page—to pass the parameter. As a result, the city product page will automatically include the city’s name in its URL or data payload. (An SEO parameter has been added here, passing the city parameter from the data source of the city product.) This allows both the product category and product name to include the city name. Second, for product categories and titles, we also need to establish a default parameter tied to the current loop, which will then pass parameters via a custom linked page. This ensures that clicking on a city link triggers the same navigation effect as clicking on the corresponding category or product name link. Similarly, the city name displayed in the product title on the detail page will be passed using the same method. City products are not recommended for manual modification of lists or details—unless you fully understand the underlying principles. Principle: If manual categorization is required, use a container for the list title to split it into two columns. Link this container to the corresponding data source (the passing method is described above). Then, enable the container's code mode and replace the innermost `div` element of the list or category title with an `H6` tag (you can also use `H1` for more detailed sections). Next, switch the city and category title (product title) into code mode, changing their enclosing `div` tags into lighter elements like `span`. This arrangement ensures that the city and title are wrapped within a single tag, allowing search engines to treat the two separate pieces of data as a unified, cohesive entity. Requires backend product management TDK setup When using the City Products app, you need to configure SEO parameters for the corresponding app within the backend TDK settings. To do this, navigate to "App," locate the relevant app, go to "Product Management," and then select "General Rule Settings." There, set the titles for the category page, list page, and detail page with SEO-optimized parameters combined with either the product name, category name, or page title. Avoid setting keywords and descriptions altogether to prevent potential semantic errors. Let's embark on a journey of digital growth together! System Construction Project Fire Safety Comprehensive Business Management Platform On April 1, 2020, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development of the People's Republic of China issued the "Provisional Regulations on the Administration of Fire Safety Design Review and Acceptance for Construction Projects." Article 4 explicitly states that the authorities responsible for fire safety design review and acceptance shall leverage internet technology and other information-based tools to carry out tasks such as fire safety design reviews, fire safety inspections, filing procedures, and random checks. Additionally, they are tasked with establishing and improving a robust credit management system for relevant organizations and practitioners, continuously enhancing the quality of government services. Product Introduction The Construction Project Fire Design Review, Acceptance, and Filing Management Platform enables three-level fire review and approval information management—spanning autonomous regions, cities, and counties. The platform integrates big data to streamline unit information entry, while also connecting with systems such as construction drawing reviews and inspection supervision, reducing the need for redundant document uploads. Additionally, it links seamlessly with project construction approval processes and the government’s integrated service platform, fostering data sharing, breaking down information silos, and enabling one-stop service acceptance and parallel approval workflows—ultimately boosting efficiency. Key Competencies Government Data Interoperability Firefighting Business Full-Process Management Standardization of Firefighting Operations Shared across provincial, municipal, and county levels Impact Value Industrial Efficiency The platform has significantly reduced the time required for fire safety review and acceptance processes, effectively supporting the district's housing and urban-rural development system in optimizing the business environment and advancing reforms to the approval system for engineering construction projects. The platform standardizes work processes, formalizes workflows, and enables real-time monitoring, alleviating audit pressures while consolidating reporting traces, minimizing discretionary decision-making, and ensuring accountability. Achieve integration with relevant departments, the Big Data Bureau, and various approval systems to enable data sharing and seamless interoperability. The platform integrates an AI-powered Q&A model equipped with a comprehensive knowledge base in the fire protection field, offering intelligent consultations and answers to enhance the convenience and expertise of review and acceptance processes. Intelligent Control Platform for Safety Risks in Chemical Industrial Parks The chemical industrial park boasts enormous output value, yet safety issues continue to surface frequently. In response, Runjian has launched an intelligent management platform for safety risks in chemical parks—a comprehensive "cloud-edge-device" collaborative solution aligned with the nation's key initiative to integrate the Industrial Internet with Safety Production. Leveraging cutting-edge technologies such as 5G, IoT, AI, and digital twins, the platform enhances the park's ability to perceive, assess, monitor, and predict safety risks, while also improving its emergency response capabilities. This innovative approach strengthens overall safety management within the park and empowers its broader digital transformation journey. Product Introduction An intelligent, digital management platform designed for safety management in chemical industrial parks, featuring six core modules: foundational safety management, critical hazard source oversight, the dual prevention mechanism, special operations management, closed-loop containment, and agile emergency response. This platform enables multi-form, multi-mode, and multi-dimensional visual monitoring, early warning, statistical analysis, and intelligent control & dispatching—covering key areas such as enterprise profiles within the park, major hazard sources, risk vulnerabilities, special operations, personnel/vehicle/logistics flows, and emergency rescue activities. Integrated Management Platform Intelligent Education and Training System Intelligent DCDU for Base Stations Under the guidance of national macro policies, domestic telecom operators have been actively expanding base station infrastructure. Meanwhile, as the collaborative construction and sharing initiative continues to advance, the number of operators co-locating their equipment at the same base station is steadily increasing. To standardize DC power management for operator base stations and ensure differentiated support for equipment from various providers, an intelligent DCDU solution tailored for all scenarios has been introduced. Product Introduction The Intelligent Distribution Unit (DCDU) serves as the battery connection port and DC output distribution point for base station switching power supplies. It offers two optional structural designs: a modular, independently pluggable switch for each circuit, or a multi-circuit, integrated design—and can be cascaded as needed. The unit supports advanced features such as differentiated backup power/generation management, precise tenant-based energy management, DC circuit/tenant (group) metering, hard-off energy-saving control for individual circuits (or residential units), and customizable blackout period management. Additionally, it allows users to define custom capacities for circuit switches and tailor circuit and group configurations to their specific needs. Key Competencies Differentiated Coverage Precise Lease Management DC Group Metering Hard-Switching Energy Saving Impact Value Industrial Efficiency It can provide differentiated backup power duration guarantees for different tenants and distinct DC circuits. It standardizes the DC power management for operators' base stations, ensuring that all output branches feature precise load-sharing control to prevent operators from illegally reconnecting their own load branches. All DC equipment within the base station is individually metered for power consumption, with customizable rules for aggregating energy data, and tenant-specific electricity bills are generated accordingly. Implement energy-saving hard shutdowns of 5G base station AAUs by cell during late-night hours, or, based on real-time traffic data analysis from the OMC, enforce hard-shutdown energy savings for either the coverage layer or the capacity layer in multi-network areas where 4G and 5G coexist. continues to evolve, the density of communication infrastructure installations will only increase. However, this surge in infrastructure comes with high energy consumption and a low adoption rate of green energy across the entire telecommunications industry. Without developing and deploying more efficient, energy-saving, and eco-friendly technologies that reduce both energy use and costs, the industry risks facing rapidly rising energy expenses. In response to the national call for energy conservation and emission reduction, installing photovoltaic power stations at base stations not only helps companies significantly cut electricity costs but also shields buildings from direct sunlight, thereby enhancing overall building energy efficiency. Product Introduction Photovoltaic modules generate direct current (DC), which is then converted into DC suitable for powering loads via an MPPT solar controller. Grid integration is achieved by connecting the system at the positive busbar of the switching power supply output and at the primary disconnect switch. The MPPT solar controller boasts strong versatility and ease of retrofitting—compatible with virtually any existing model or brand of switching power supply currently in operation. With just a simple modification, even communication power systems that currently rely solely on AC power can be seamlessly adapted to support a hybrid solar-plus-grid power configuration. Key Competencies High发电 efficiency Anti-occlusion capability One-stop service Minimalist Operations Impact Value Industrial Efficiency The MPPT controller can track the maximum power point in real time, ensuring the system always operates at its optimal power generation state. Optional photovoltaic adapters can boost power generation by up to 30% even under shading conditions. Providing end-to-end management services—covering consulting, site surveys, design, procurement, construction, operations & maintenance, and full-cycle management—all in a one-stop service. Paired with Runjian's proprietary iEACP-Photovoltaic Maintenance Platform, it enables real-time monitoring of power generation status, automatic dispatch of alert work orders, and on-demand customization of various reports, delivering ultra-simplified operations and maintenance. Strongly promote the use of clean energy in base stations to reduce operational costs. high-quality development of new infrastructure such as data centers, we are leveraging fluoropump dual-loop air conditioners in diverse settings—including communication equipment rooms and data centers—to achieve energy-efficient temperature control. This initiative further drives the data center industry toward more sustainable, environmentally friendly, and secure operations. Product Introduction The fluoropump dual-loop air conditioner features three operational modes: mechanical cooling, hybrid cooling, and fluoropump cooling. The system automatically selects the most efficient mode based on the indoor cooling load and outdoor ambient temperature changes, maximizing energy savings by leveraging natural cooling sources. It also boasts characteristics such as safety, reliability, easy maintenance, and exceptional energy efficiency, fully meeting the advanced temperature management requirements of next-generation green data centers. Key Competencies High-efficiency and energy-saving Multi-mode operation Flexible configuration Safe and reliable Impact Value Industrial Efficiency Fully inverter-designed, featuring an inverter-driven fluoropump and an inverter-compressor for combined cooling—this system dynamically matches the data center's load in real time, ensuring reliable operation. Multi-condition operation with automatic switching among three modes: mechanical cooling, hybrid cooling, and fluoropump cooling, maximizing the use of natural cold sources. The indoor unit can be configured on demand in room-level or aisle-level configurations, while the outdoor unit can be equipped with either a centralized or flat-type condenser as needed. Heat exchange inside the facility occurs via refrigerant circulation, with water kept entirely out of the machine room, eliminating any risk of water-related hazards. power has grown rapidly, and the development and application of non-fossil energy are steadily gaining momentum. To maintain grid balance and stability while boosting the integration of renewable energy, various types of virtual power plants have emerged swiftly across China. As a unique type of power plant, virtual power plants serve as a coordinated management system that seamlessly integrates into electricity markets and grid operations. They can function both as "positive power plants," reducing electricity consumption to help ease peak demand on the grid, and as "negative power plants," increasing consumption to fill valleys in electricity usage. Capable of responding swiftly to grid signals, virtual power plants not only help stabilize the power system and earn financial incentives but also enable participation in diverse electricity market activities—such as capacity trading, spot markets, and ancillary services—thereby unlocking significant economic benefits. Product Introduction The RunDoBidder Virtual Power Plant leverages a self-developed, embedded AI-powered edge intelligence terminal to aggregate flexible resources from distributed electricity users—such as rooftop solar, energy storage systems, EV charging stations, air conditioners, and 5G base stations. These resources are seamlessly integrated and connected in real time with the grid’s dispatch center. By combining advanced features like price forecasting, load prediction, AGC/APC control, and quantitative trading, the system dynamically tracks minute-by-minute fluctuations in electricity prices and intelligently adjusts energy consumption strategies. This enables virtual power plant operators to achieve dual profitability: optimizing participation in electricity market trading while delivering essential grid ancillary services. Key Competencies Embedded AI Technology Price/Load Forecasting AGC/APC Quantitative Trading Impact Value Industrial Efficiency Supporting the nation's "Dual Carbon" strategy, ensuring the safe and stable operation of the power grid, and promoting the integration of new energy sources. By replacing low-efficiency equipment, optimizing airflow management, and upgrading energy-saving technologies, we aim to help operators reduce energy consumption and costs, further driving the "energy-efficient, environmentally friendly, and secure" evolution of data center and base station operations. Fluoride Pump Air Conditioner To support the achievement of "carbon peaking and carbon neutrality" goals and promote the green, high-quality development of new infrastructure such as data centers, we are leveraging fluoropump dual-loop air conditioners in diverse settings—including communication equipment rooms and data centers—to achieve energy-efficient temperature control. This initiative further drives the data center industry toward more sustainable, environmentally friendly, and secure operations. Photovoltaic system for base station equipment rooms As 5G technology continues to evolve, the density of communication infrastructure installations will only increase. However, this surge in infrastructure comes with high energy consumption and a low adoption rate of green energy across the entire telecommunications industry. Without developing and deploying more efficient, energy-saving, and eco-friendly technologies that reduce both energy use and costs, the industry risks facing rapidly rising energy expenses. In response to the national call for energy conservation and emission reduction, installing photovoltaic power stations at base stations not only helps companies significantly cut electricity costs but also shields buildings from direct sunlight, thereby enhancing overall building energy efficiency. Smart Fresh Air for Base Stations To support the achievement of the "carbon peak and carbon neutrality" goals and promote the green, high-quality development of new infrastructure such as base stations, in regions rich in natural cooling resources, we are leveraging smart fresh-air energy-saving equipment to efficiently harness these natural cold sources. This approach aims to reduce energy consumption in base station equipment rooms, further advancing the transition toward "energy-efficient, environmentally friendly, and secure" operations for base station facilities. Rack-mounted air conditioner With the rapid advancement of larger-capacity, faster 5G networks, the demand for base station cooling has surged significantly, leading to an increase in high-temperature alarms at base stations. To ensure the safe and stable operation of these critical infrastructure facilities, there is an urgent need to upgrade to air-conditioning equipment with higher cooling capacities, enabling precise temperature control within the equipment cabinets. This move not only supports the ambitious goals of "carbon peaking" and "carbon neutrality," but also accelerates the green, high-quality development of new infrastructure like 5G base stations. Ultimately, it will further drive the evolution of 5G base station operations toward greater energy efficiency, environmental sustainability, and operational safety. Intelligent DCDU for Base Stations Under the guidance of national macro policies, domestic telecom operators have been actively expanding base station infrastructure. Meanwhile, as the collaborative construction and sharing initiative continues to advance, the number of operators co-locating their equipment at the same base station is steadily increasing. To standardize DC power management for operator base stations and ensure differentiated support for equipment from various providers, an intelligent DCDU solution tailored for all scenarios has been introduced. This cutting-edge technology is emerging as a key driver of a revolutionary shift in the web development landscape. Traditional website development typically requires specialized expertise and significant time investment, but with the advancement of AI and automation technologies, AI-powered website-building tools have emerged to dramatically simplify the process. These tools leverage machine learning and advanced algorithms to automatically generate website layouts, designs, and content, enabling users to create their own websites faster and more effortlessly than ever before. AI website-building technology features intelligent recommendations and customization capabilities, enabling it to generate personalized website design plans tailored to user needs and industry characteristics. By analyzing vast amounts of data and user preferences, these tools can deliver bespoke website solutions that meet the diverse requirements of different users. This technology is particularly appealing to individual creators, small and medium-sized businesses, and startups, as it not only saves time and reduces costs but also lowers the technical barrier, enabling more people to effortlessly build professional-quality websites. However, despite the many conveniences brought about by AI-powered website-building technology, it still faces several challenges, including limitations in customization and difficulties adapting to specific design aesthetics. Additionally, ensuring the quality and security of the generated websites remains an area where this technology continues to require ongoing improvement. Overall, the rise of AI-powered website-building technology marks a significant advancement in the web development industry, offering more people the opportunity to create their own websites—and signaling that website development is moving toward smarter, more user-friendly solutions. text: Two Major “Quchi” Platforms of Runjian Co., Ltd. were selected as the First Batch of Artificial Intelligence Service Platforms-Runjian Co., Ltd. | Malaysia AI Smart Maintenance Products & Solutions Industry-Scale Large Models Energy industry Government and Enterprise Sector Business Operations Human-machine collaboration Industry-Scale Large Models Energy industry Government and Enterprise Sector Business Operations Human-machine collaboration Case Center Ecological Cooperation Collaboration Approach Partner Registration Collaboration Approach Partner Registration About Us About Us Party Building News Culture Human Resources Recruitment Talent development Contact Us About Us Party Building News Culture Human Resources Recruitment Talent development Contact Us Technical Wiki English Chinese 搜索历史 清除全部记录 最多显示8条历史搜索记录噢~ All All News and Information Product Center Runjian Updates Marketing Campaign Strategic Partnership Corporate Honors Public Notice Two Major “Quchi” Platforms of Runjian Co., Ltd. were selected as the First Batch of Artificial Intelligence Service Platforms 2025-10-22 13:56 Source: Author: To implement the decision-making arrangements issued by the State Council of China on advancing the "Artificial Intelligence+" initiative and to enhance the foundational capabilities in the intelligent era, the Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region Big Data Development Bureau officially announced the first batch of 12 artificial intelligence service platforms recently. Runjian Co., Ltd.'s self-developed "Quchi Artificial Intelligence Open Platform" and "Quchi Data Annotation Platform" were successfully selected, bringing strong momentum into regional digital economic development. These platforms cover three main categories: computing power services, model services, and data services, providing society with universal, standardized, and professional AI foundational capabilities services. It aims to focus on AI technology research and development, application promotion, and industry empowerment, and create a number of demonstrative and innovative AI service platforms. In May 2025, Runjian Co., Ltd.'s "Quchi Communication Operations and Maintenance Large Model" was officially registered with the Cyberspace Administration of China, becoming the first large model in Guangxi to be registered with the Central Cyberspace Office. Now, the company's two major AI platforms have been successfully selected as Guangxi's first batch of AI service platforms, marking the company's continued industry recognition for its technological R&D and application service capabilities in the field of artificial intelligence. This will further promote the deep integration of AI technologies with the real economy, empowering intelligent upgrading across various industries. Runjian Co., Ltd. Quchi Artificial Intelligence Open Platform Runjian’s self-developed "Quchi" industry model platform targets enterprise-level AI applications, building a full-chain capability from data-model-agent-application-operation and maintenance: with data annotation and model production lines as the foundation, large model gateway and online development platform as the hub, and AI Agent orchestration as the starting point, it promotes the industry from "experience-driven" to "intelligence-driven." The Quchi Artificial Intelligence Open Platform is a generative AI model development platform aimed at industry applications. Relying on the powerful computing power of the Wuxiang Cloud Valley Smart Computing Center, the platform focuses on multimodal algorithm training such as vision, speech, and text, deeply integrating large models and intelligent agent technologies. It supports the entire development process from data preprocessing, model training, fine-tuning, deployment, and scene application integration. It features two core businesses: - Intelligent Agent Platform, a one-stop experience and operation center for creating industry intelligent agents. It integrates the display, experience, management, and capabilities of intelligent entities across various industries, allowing business teams to trial them online. It supports both online and offline trials, as well as small-scale phased trials, ensuring both stability and compliance, making online launches more worry-free. On the operational side, key metrics such as conversation quality, knowledge matching, tool success rates, and response speed can be compared, evaluated, and continuously optimized, making results visible and improvements easier. - Computing Power Mall, offering ready-to-use multi-specification computing resources. It offers a variety of computing power cards and instances, covering different memory and throughput requirements (such as SE, PE, and edge box series), meeting the full-process needs of training, fine-tuning, and inference. It seamlessly integrates with model production lines and online development, offering flexible and transparent billing and delivery options, including pay-per-use, time-based, or packaged options. With enterprise certification and a standard "consultation-order-delivery-monitoring" process, instances can be seamlessly integrated into the R&D pipeline upon activation, allowing you to directly submit training/fine-tuning services or publish to the large model gateway for inference services with one click. Quchi Data Annotation Platform This platform addresses efficiency and accuracy issues in the data annotation stage of the AI industry chain, providing high-quality "data fuel" for AI model training. The Quchi Data Annotation Platform consists of a system interaction layer, functional modules, and a foundational platform layer, covering full workflows from data management, pre-identification processing, task flow, to tool management, flexibly meeting annotation needs for diverse data types and multi-organizational collaboration. In terms of functions, the foundational platform layer integrates annotation task platform, system management platform, template tools, and data processing libraries, and is fully responsible for task distribution, system operation and maintenance, template standardization, and multi-data type handling, ensuring the stability and high performance of the platform operation. Through rigorous process design and multi-round quality inspection mechanisms, it achieves standardized annotation management. In terms of security, the built-in advanced smart pre-annotation algorithm greatly improve annotation efficiency, while also providing comprehensive security and operational control, such as login authentication, data verification, service governance, log auditing and cluster services, etc., to ensure the compliance of the entire data processing process, operational traceability and high system availability. Being selected as one of Guangxi's first artificial intelligence service platforms is not only a strong affirmation of the technological advancement and practical value of Runjian Co., Ltd.'s Quchi AI open platform, but also provides an important opportunity for the platform to serve the development of the digital economy on a broader scale. Looking ahead, Runjian will actively collaborate with ecosystem partners to promote the deep integration and large-scale application of AI technologies across industries, contributing to the vigorous development of the global digital economy. text: Ruijian Co., Ltd. and Schneider Electric Signed a Strategic Cooperation Agreement to Promote Green and High-Efficiency Development of Computing Power Infrastructure-Runjian Co., Ltd. | Malaysia AI Smart Maintenance Products & Solutions Industry-Scale Large Models Energy industry Government and Enterprise Sector Business Operations Human-machine collaboration Industry-Scale Large Models Energy industry Government and Enterprise Sector Business Operations Human-machine collaboration Case Center Ecological Cooperation Collaboration Approach Partner Registration Collaboration Approach Partner Registration About Us About Us Party Building News Culture Human Resources Recruitment Talent development Contact Us About Us Party Building News Culture Human Resources Recruitment Talent development Contact Us Technical Wiki English Chinese 搜索历史 清除全部记录 最多显示8条历史搜索记录噢~ All All News and Information Product Center Runjian Updates Marketing Campaign Strategic Partnership Corporate Honors Public Notice Ruijian Co., Ltd. and Schneider Electric Signed a Strategic Cooperation Agreement to Promote Green and High-Efficiency Development of Computing Power Infrastructure 2025-11-07 00:00 Source: Author: At the 8th China International Import Expo, Ruijian Co., Ltd. and Schneider Electric (China) Co., Ltd. officially signed a strategic cooperation agreement. Jiang Binbin, Vice President of Schneider Electric China and Head of Sales for the South China Region, Li Jimin, Vice President of Schneider Electric China, head of Industry Sales and Development for national sales, Xie Weibin, Regional Sales Manager for South China, Li Bo, Data Center Business Development Manager, Central Industry Department, Chen Pan, General Manager of IDC Business Department and Vice President of Overseas Business Group of Runjian Co., Ltd., Li Qi, General Manager of the Ecological Cooperation Department, Liu Bin, Deputy General Manager of the Supply Chain Department, Miao Huamin, Market Director, and other guests attended and witnessed the signing ceremony. The two parties will engage in in-depth cooperation in the fields of computing infrastructure construction and green and low-carbon development, jointly creating efficient, reliable, and sustainable computing infrastructure solutions to help achieve the country’s "dual carbon" goals and the implementation of digital economy development strategies. Three Major Areas of Cooperation to Promote High-Quality Development This agreement focuses on three core areas of in-depth cooperation. First, jointly establishing an end-to-end cooperation mechanism to form a collaborative system of "joint solution development, joint project expansion, and joint service guarantee" around the needs of computing power project implementation, thereby strengthening the core competitiveness of both parties. Second, jointly building a service system for the transformation of existing computing infrastructure, carrying out systematic upgrades and intelligent transformations of old IDC data centers and traditional computing nodes, and setting a benchmark for computing infrastructure transformation. Third, establishing a green energy-saving service system for computing infrastructure, combining Ruijian’s technical strengths in full-scope data center operation and maintenance with Schneider Electric’s core capabilities in AI BOX cooling source energy-saving optimization and SmartCool terminal air conditioning energy savings, to promote the development of high-quality, low-energy-consumption, and sustainable computing infrastructure. Strong Alliance to Solidify Computing Power Foundations As a global leader in energy technology, Schneider Electric drives efficiency and sustainability across industries, enterprises, and households through electrification, automation, and digital intelligence solutions. Its technology covers smart devices, software-defined architectures, AI-powered systems, digital services, and expert consulting, ensuring stable operation of buildings, data centers, factories, infrastructure, and power grids within an open and interactive ecosystem, while enhancing performance, resilience, and sustainability. Schneider Electric has been repeatedly recognized as one of the most sustainable companies worldwide, with over 160,000 employees and more than one million partners across over 100 countries. As one of China’s top 500 service enterprises and one of the top 100 software enterprises, Ruijian has consistently adhered to its core strategy of "AI-driven, green computing power collaboration, and intelligent maintenance for hundreds of industries." It has built an integrated intelligent operation and maintenance system covering communication network, digital network, and energy network. Its service network covers 29 provinces, over 200 cities, and more than 1,300 districts and counties across the country. Ruijian has successfully implemented major projects such as the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area Intelligent Computing Power Center, China Telecom ASEAN International Information Park, Zhuhai Aiko Apollo Data Center, National Supercomputing Center in Shenzhen, and China-ASEAN Artificial Intelligence Computing Power Center, demonstrating advanced technical capabilities. Dedicated to becoming an industry-leading provider of AI industry models and computing power services, Ruijian has built a three-in-one AI full-stack service capability integrating "computing power + algorithm + scenario". It has developed the "Quchi" AI open platform, which supports multimodal development and industry customization. The Wuxiang Cloud Valley Intelligent Computing Center, which it has invested in and built, can accommodate more than 40,000P of computing power and has won several top certifications such as National Green Data Center and Green Energy Saving 5A. More than 100 intelligent agents have been implemented in industries such as communications, energy, education, medical care, agriculture, and government affairs, promoting the intelligent upgrading of industries. The strategic cooperation between Runjian Technology and Schneider Electric represents not only a powerful alliance in technology and market, but also a significant milestone in the deep integration of the company's green energy technology and intelligent computing power. In the future, both sides will establish an end-to-end cooperation mechanism, leveraging Ruijian’s extensive experience and resources in computing power center infrastructure construction and operation, along with Schneider Electric’s top-tier international technology and solutions in high and low voltage power distribution, energy-saving transformation, and energy management. Together, they will jointly build a service system for the renovation of existing computing power infrastructure and a green energy-saving service system. This will promote the deep integration of computing power and energy businesses, bringing new momentum into the green and intelligent development of the industry! Runjian Co., Ltd. and Guangxi Medical University Rank Among Top 5% Globally in AI Comprehensive Algorithm Ranking 2025-12-14 18:00 Source: Author: Following DeepMind's AlphaFold technology winning the 2024 Nobel Prize in Chemistry, global artificial intelligence is profoundly reshaping the landscape of biomedical research. The “Virtual Cell” is regarded as the next scientific frontier beyond protein structure prediction, while the research direction dubbed the “ultimate Virtual Cell” is widely recognized by the international scientific community as highly likely to continue making Nobel Prize-level breakthroughs in the future, fundamentally transforming the research paradigm in biomedicine. Recently, in the globally acclaimed “Medical Virtual Cell” strategic competition, a joint research team formed by Runjian Co., Ltd. and Guangxi Medical University actively participated in the Virtual Cell Challenge—hailed as the pinnacle of medical artificial intelligence competitions. They competed alongside teams from world-renowned universities such as Harvard, Yale, and Stanford, as well as leading global AI laboratories and top life science research institutions. Ultimately, the Ruanjian-Guangxi Medical University joint team emerged from 5,121 top medical AI research teams across 114 countries and regions. Their core metric DES (0.29) ranked 35th globally, while their overall algorithm placement secured a spot within the top 5% worldwide, earning recognition from this premier international technology competition. On June 26, 2025, researchers from the internationally renowned AI laboratory Arc Institute published a paper titled “Virtual Cell Challenge: Toward a Turing Test for the Virtual Cell” in the top-tier academic journal Cell. This article formally launched the Virtual Cell Challenge, whose core objective is to provide a fair and open testing framework. Toward a Turing Test for the Virtual Cell. This commentary formally launched the Virtual Cell Challenge, whose core objective is to provide a fair and open evaluation framework to identify the best virtual cell models capable of passing rigorous testing. The initiative aims to unite global scientific efforts to tackle the challenges of virtual cell modeling and accelerate the transition from laboratory research to practical applications. Virtual cells represent the core engineering project for constructing a digital life medical system, regarded as indispensable infrastructure for future precision medicine, drug development, disease modeling, and diagnostic treatment. International experts widely agree that mastering core virtual cell technologies will secure a strategic vantage point in the era of biomedical and artificial intelligence convergence. The launch of the Virtual Cell Challenge marks an exciting new phase in AI-empowered life sciences. It is not merely a competition, but a pivotal step in building the foundation for future digital biology. When AI virtual cells can pass rigorous “Turing tests” and accurately predict the behavior of life's most fundamental units, humanity's understanding and ability to intervene in life will enter an unprecedented new era. Virtual Cell Challenge Overview (Source: Cell): In the Virtual Cell Challenge, participants will develop virtual cell models to predict the effects of genetic and chemical perturbations on transcriptional activity within cell populations. Given an unperturbed cellular state, the task involves inferring how gene expression responds to specific perturbations. In this world-class medical AI competition, the joint team from Runjian Co., Ltd. and Guangxi Medical University demonstrated its capability to independently master core medical AI algorithm modeling technologies, possessing a complete technical solution spanning from foundational model construction to system-level biomedical simulation. This achievement not only signifies the deep integration of Runjian Co., Ltd.'s AI capabilities with Guangxi Medical University's cutting-edge research but also demonstrates the team's capacity to compete with the world's strongest medical AI laboratories on key technologies and achieve partial surpassing. Runjian Co., Ltd. and Guangxi Medical University achieved outstanding results in an international AI competition, propelling Guangxi's medical artificial intelligence onto the global stage as a leading force in the field and a significant representative of China's capabilities. This accomplishment not only signifies high recognition of Runjian's AI technological prowess and industry application achievements but also affirms the company's innovative leadership role in regional industrial development. Runjian will continue advancing algorithm and model optimization to deliver more internationally influential original innovations across multiple industry sectors. Runjian Co., Ltd. is committed to becoming an industry-leading provider of artificial intelligence models and computing power services, having established a comprehensive AI service ecosystem spanning the entire chain from data to models, intelligent agents, applications, and operations. Moving forward, the company will continue to uphold its core strategy of “AI-driven, green computing synergy, and intelligent maintenance for all industries.” It will intensify R&D investment and innovation exploration in the AI field, continuously expand the boundaries of AI-empowered industries, and help Chinese technologies and solutions reach the global stage. Runjian and Guangxi Minzu University jointly unveil the "International Chinese Online" platform to boost global exchange. 2026-01-16 00:00 Source: Author: On January 14, the unveiling ceremony of the School of International Chinese Education and the official launch of the “International Chinese Online” platform were held at the Cultural Studies Base of Guangxi Minzu University. Senior representatives from Guangxi Minzu University, renowned scholars from leading Chinese universities, and executives from Runjian Co., Ltd. attended the event and jointly inaugurated the platform. Jointly developed by Runjian Co., Ltd. and Guangxi Minzu University, the International Chinese Online is an AI-powered education platform designed to support the global development of Chinese language education. Driven by advanced artificial intelligence technologies, the platform integrates: • Standardized HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) curricula • Localized teaching case libraries tailored for ASEAN learners • High-quality teaching resources Together, these elements form a comprehensive ASEAN-focused “learning–teaching–research” ecosystem. The platform precisely addresses the evolving needs of Chinese language education in the ASEAN region. By leveraging AI, it empowers three core modules — language learning, teaching, and research — seamlessly embedding technology throughout the educational process and setting a new benchmark for digital innovation in international Chinese education. At the event, Li Qunwei, Head of Guangxi Region at Runjian Co., Ltd., stated that this collaboration represents a precise alignment of the academic heritage of higher education institutions with the technological strengths of enterprises, turning the platform vision into reality. He emphasized that university-enterprise collaboration is the optimal path to empower education through technology: universities delve deeply into educational needs, while enterprises excel at implementing technological solutions. Only when both parties resonate in harmony can innovative outcomes truly serve the goal of nurturing talent. Congratulatory video messages were sent by academic leaders from universities in Thailand, Laos, and Indonesia, who highly recognized the platform’s role in promoting international Chinese communication and strengthening global cultural exchange. As a leading provider of AI industry models and computing power services, Runjian Co., Ltd. is dedicated to advanceing high-quality industrial development through AI empowerment. The launch of International Chinese Online marks not only another key milestone in Runjian’s “AI + Education” journey, but demonstrates its commitment to facilitating the expansion of China ’ s innovative achievements into ASEAN markets. Runjian Signs MOA with TAR UMT Malaysia to Build AI Computing Power Alliance 2026-04-30 22:21 Source: Author: Recently, Runjian Co., Ltd. officially signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) with Tunku Abdul Rahman University of Management and Technology (TAR UMT) in Kuala Lumpur to jointly establish an AI Computing Power Alliance , aiming to build a benchmark platform for university computing power sharing, scientific research innovation and talent development for ASEAN. This cooperation marks the official launch of TAR UMT’s first dedicated AI computing center, which will promote AI innovation and facilitate academic research and industrial applications for Malaysian enterprises. Prof. Dato' Indera Engineer. Dr. Lee Sze Wei, President of TAR UMT, and Ding Yong, Vice President of Runjian and President of AI Business Group, signed the agreement on behalf of both parties. Prof. Dr. Loke Chui Fong, Vice President of TAR UMT, and Yin Jie, Vice President of Runjian AI Business Group, witnessed the signing ceremony. Prof. Dr. Lim Tong Ming, Dean of Enterprise Incubation and Entrepreneurship Center of TAR UMT, Mr. Novie Tajuddin, CEO of Education Malaysia Global Services, Zhao Hua, President of Runjian Overseas Business Group, Zhou Guanyu, Dean of Runjian Energy Digitalization Research Institute, and other distinguished guests attended the event to witness the launch of the AI Computing Power Alliance. Prof. Lee Sze Wei, President of TAR UMT, stated that artificial intelligence is profoundly shaping the modern world with rapid innovation. He pointed out that such industrial cooperation is crucial to ensure relevant and strategic knowledge transfer, and empower the university community to achieve innovative and original achievements. TAR UMT’s first AI center will expose students to real AI application scenarios and fully prepare them for a future driven by emerging technologies. Ding Yong, Vice President of Runjian, further elaborated on the cooperation. He said that Runjian will provide the university with advanced and practical AI technologies to help cultivate market-ready professionals, create value for industries in the region, and jointly boost the innovation and development of China-ASEAN artificial intelligence. Malaysia is striving to build a digital economy hub in Southeast Asia, where data centers and computing infrastructure have become core pillars of the digital industry. Guided by the government’s green and sustainable development policies, local universities face surging demand for high-performance, green and low-carbon computing power for AI research, teaching and training, while commonly suffering from scattered resources, insufficient supply and limited funding. As a prestigious and comprehensive top university in Malaysia with strong expertise in ICT, engineering and digital innovation, TAR UMT is in urgent need of a stable and efficient computing foundation to support breakthroughs in research and teaching. As a leading industrial AI model and computing power service provider, Runjian adheres to the strategy of “AI-driven, Green Computing Synergy, Intelligent Services for All Industries” and boasts full-stack AI service capabilities of “Computing Power + Platform + Industrial Applications”. With self-developed Quchi AI Open Platform and Wuxiang Cloud Valley AI Computing Center (certified as a National Green Data Center), Runjian has accumulated mature experience in major projects such as the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area and China-ASEAN AI Computing Center, and its overseas business has deeply covered ASEAN markets including Malaysia and Indonesia. Under the agreement, the two parties will carry out in-depth cooperation focusing on three major directions: Build a computing power alliance with hybrid distributed and centralized architecture to meet local teaching and data security needs through university distributed nodes, and support large-scale AI training and high-performance computing through centralized computing centers, realizing unified resource scheduling and elastic supply. Develop green and low-carbon modular computing power nodes with energy-saving cooling and intelligent power supply technologies, adapting to Malaysia’s tropical climate, reducing PUE and meeting local sustainable development standards for data centers. Establish an industry-university-research collaborative platform for AI talent training, curriculum development, internship and practical training, and transformation of scientific research achievements, helping universities break through computing bottlenecks and enhance digital technology innovation capabilities. This cooperation will effectively fill the computing power gap of universities, promote the in-depth integration of AI with various disciplines, and cultivate more digital talents for Malaysia. Runjian will leverage its advantages in computing construction, green energy conservation and intelligent operation and maintenance to implement mature green computing solutions in Malaysia, empowering ASEAN education and digital industry development with technology. The strategic cooperation with TAR UMT is an important milestone for Runjian to deepen the ASEAN market and promote the internationalization of computing services. In the future, both parties will continue to deepen collaboration, take the computing power alliance as a carrier to promote efficient interaction of technologies, resources and talents. Debuts at SNEC 2026, Unveiling a New Blueprint for AI-enabled Energy Industry! 2026-06-08 11:20 Source: Author: SNEC 2026 kicked off on June 3 at the National Exhibition and Convention Center (Shanghai). Centered on the theme Integrated PV & Energy Storage, Smartly Shaping the Future , the event gathers over 3,000 global exhibitors and more than 500,000 professional visitors. Under the theme Let the Energy Enter the Token Era , Runjian Co., Ltd. showcases the integrated innovation of AI × Token × Energy to connect with worldwide industry clients and partners. Runjian presents the full-industry-chain offerings, the Wuxiang Cloud Valley AI Computing Center, Quchi AI Open Platform and a full chain service of intelligent energy products across four core segments: Token Base, Token Factory, Token Services and Token Overseas Expansion. Token Base : Full-lifecycle services covering wind, PV, energy storage and charging sectors. our domestic installed capacity under O&M exceeds 33GW, with over 7GW of completed EPC projects. Token Factory : Built upon its proprietary AI computing center and AI open platform, it delivers on-demand Token computing resources to slash enterprises’ costs for AI implementation. Token Services : Highlights include the full RunDo digital energy platform, virtual power plants and smart microgrids, alongside three turnkey solutions: zero-carbon park development, data center energy retrofitting and charging & battery swapping O&M. The booth also features UAV inspection systems, PV panel cleaning robots and humanoid O&M robots, forming an integrated intelligent O&M ecosystem of UAV + Robot + AI Platform . Token Going Global : Rooted in the ASEAN market, Runjian has delivered over 500 local projects and more than 80 data & computing center developments, with on-site display of our overseas new energy implementation cases. Meanwhile, Runjian hosted the Practical AI · Expert Insights tech salon via hybrid online livestream and on-site sharing. Two flagship products were officially launched: the brand-new RunDoBidder VPP platform enables power plants to join electricity trading for stable revenue growth; the power-computation synergy solution realizes Source-Grid-Load-Storage-Computation integration by transmitting electricity price signals to link power supply and computing capacity. In addition, experts shared intelligent cooling solutions for data centers, cutting facility power consumption via equipment upgrade and AI-driven HVAC intelligent control. Going forward, sticking to its development strategy of AI-Driven, Green Computing Synergy, Intelligent O&M for All Industries , Runjian will further deepen the integration of AI and energy sectors to pioneer new value creation models for the new energy industry. text: Green Computing Power × Token Factory — ASEAN Green Intelligent Computing and AI Innovation Ecosystem Conference Held Successfully at WAIC 2026-Runjian Co., Ltd. | Malaysia AI Smart Maintenance Products & Solutions Industry-Scale Large Models Energy industry Government and Enterprise Sector Business Operations Human-machine collaboration Industry-Scale Large Models Energy industry Government and Enterprise Sector Business Operations Human-machine collaboration Case Center Ecological Cooperation Collaboration Approach Partner Registration Collaboration Approach Partner Registration About Us About Us Party Building News Culture Human Resources Recruitment Talent development Contact Us About Us Party Building News Culture Human Resources Recruitment Talent development Contact Us Technical Wiki English Chinese 搜索历史 清除全部记录 最多显示8条历史搜索记录噢~ All All News and Information Product Center Runjian Updates Marketing Campaign Strategic Partnership Corporate Honors Public Notice Green Computing Power × Token Factory — ASEAN Green Intelligent Computing and AI Innovation Ecosystem Conference Held Successfully at WAIC 2026 2026-07-27 16:18 Source: Author: On July 18, during WAIC 2026 (World Artificial Intelligence Conference) , the “Green Computing Power × Token Factory — ASEAN Green Intelligent Computing and AI Innovation Ecosystem Conference” was successfully held at the WAIC venue. The conference was guided by the Office of the World Artificial Intelligence Conference Organizing Committee, Nanning Municipal People’s Government, Cyberspace Administration of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, China Council for the Promotion of International Trade Guangxi Sub-council, Secretariat of the China-ASEAN Business and Investment Summit, Guangxi Big Data Development Bureau, China-ASEAN Artificial Intelligence Application Cooperation Center, Guangxi Department of Commerce, Foreign Affairs Office of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region, Guangxi Association for Science and Technology, among other organizations. The event was hosted by Runjian Co., Ltd. and Wuxiang Cloud Valley , organized by Entrepreneurship China (CYZone), Shenzhen Artificial Intelligence Industry Association, and Guangxi Artificial Intelligence Industry Alliance , with support from Guangxi Artificial Intelligence Society and Guangxi Electronic Information Association . The conference focused on the complete value chain of “Green Energy Infrastructure — Token Factory — Token Services — Token Globalization — Industrial Ecosystem” , bringing together government representatives, academicians, experts, industry leaders, and ecosystem partners from China and ASEAN countries to explore new development pathways for industries in the Token era. During the event, several major initiatives were officially launched, including: Wuxiang Cloud Valley Token Factory RONZON Platform Runjian·Zhiyu AI Security Product Series Runjian Token Sales and Service System Meanwhile, strategic cooperation agreements on China-ASEAN Token development and ecosystem collaboration were signed. Runjian Co., Ltd. also partnered with the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology (CAICT) to launch research and standardization initiatives for the Token Factory industry. Through multi-party collaboration, the conference injected new momentum into China-ASEAN cooperation in the digital economy. Industry Insights: Exploring New Opportunities for China-ASEAN Collaboration As artificial intelligence enters the era of reasoning and large-scale model applications continue to accelerate, Token is emerging as a new fundamental production factor connecting computing power, AI models, and industrial applications. Focusing on key topics including green computing infrastructure, China-ASEAN digital cooperation, and Token industry development, the conference gathered leading experts and industry representatives to discuss future opportunities. Li Guangshao, Deputy Secretary of the Party Leadership Group of Nanning Municipal Government and Executive Deputy Director of the Management Committee of Wuxiang New Area, delivered the opening remarks. He shared Nanning’s strategic planning and development initiatives for advancing the green computing industry through Wuxiang New Area. Yang Yanyan, President of the China Council for the Promotion of International Trade Guangxi Sub-council, Secretary-General of the China-ASEAN Business and Investment Summit Secretariat, and Secretary-General of the China-ASEAN Business Council Joint Secretariat, shared insights into Guangxi’s latest progress in promoting cross-border industrial cooperation and digital economy exchanges under the framework of China-ASEAN digital collaboration. As the host representative, Xu Wenjie, President of Runjian Co., Ltd., delivered a keynote speech titled “Runjian’s Token Strategy and Vision.” He introduced Runjian’s strategic framework of: “Token as the Core, Green Computing Collaboration, Intelligent Operations Empowering Industries.” The speech highlighted Runjian’s full-stack Token capability system covering: Token Production Token Services Token Globalization Industrial Ecosystem Development Xu Wenjie expressed the company’s commitment to working with more industry partners to elevate China-ASEAN cooperation in artificial intelligence to a new level. Focusing on technological advancement, Academician Ling Wen from the Chinese Academy of Engineering delivered a keynote speech titled “Integrated Engineering of Computing, Data, Energy and Networks.” He emphasized the need to accelerate the development of a green, efficient, and secure next-generation infrastructure system to support large-scale AI applications. Peng Shaoliang, Deputy Director of the National Supercomputing Center in Changsha at Hunan University, shared practical experiences in integrated computing and energy systems as well as global expansion of computing capabilities, with a focus on open-source AI models and intelligent agents. Global Launch of Token Ecosystem Solutions and Products During the product launch session, Runjian Co., Ltd. officially unveiled its comprehensive suite of platforms, products, and service systems built around the Token industry value chain , showcasing its latest innovations to the global industry community. Deng Chongzhi, Chief Technical Expert of Shanghai Xinhong Intelligent Technology Co., Ltd. and RONZON (Nanning) Technology Co., Ltd. , introduced and explained the RONZON Platform of Wuxiang Cloud Valley Token Factory , highlighting its core capabilities in Token production, scheduling, delivery, and operations . Wu Minhua, General Manager of Shanghai Lichan Technology Co., Ltd. , Dong Weijun, General Manager of Wuxiang Cloud Valley Co., Ltd. , Hua Minglei, General Manager of RONZON (Nanning) Technology Co., Ltd. , and Ding Yong, Director and Vice President of Runjian Co., Ltd. , jointly witnessed the global launch ceremony of the RONZON Platform of Wuxiang Cloud Valley Token Factory . The platform will further enhance Token production capabilities and operational efficiency, supporting the development of a more mature Token ecosystem. As AI applications continue to accelerate, data security, LLM security, and agent security have become critical concerns across the industry. In response to this trend, Runjian Co., Ltd. officially launched the “Runjian·Zhiyu” Intelligent Security Product Series at the conference. Dr. Chu Ge, Chief AI Security Scientist of Runjian Co., Ltd., provided a systematic introduction to the capabilities and application scenarios of four key products — Hive 、 G ate K eeper 、 Model I nspection and Model Shield — presenting a comprehensive security framework covering the entire Token lifecycle . Witnessed by Chen Junhai, expert from the Cybersecurity Brigade of the Public Security Department of Guangxi Zhuang Autonomous Region; Cui Hanxin, Chief Information Officer of Guangxi Beibu Gulf Bank ; Peng Lin, President of TBEA Intelligent Research Institute ; Wang Jitian, Deputy General Manager of the Port Logistics Business Division of Guangxi Beibu Gulf Big Data Technology Co., Ltd. ; and Liu Zhipei, Senior Security Expert at Guangdong Nanfang Information Security Research Institute , the “Runjian·Zhiyu” Intelligent Security Product Series made its global debut. With the continuous development of the Token industry ecosystem, the establishment of comprehensive service systems has become a key driver for industry growth. During the forum, Runjian Co., Ltd. also launched its Token Sales and Service System . Huang Haijiang, Executive Vice President of Runjian’s TOKEN Business Group, provided an in-depth overview of the system’s service model, delivery process, and ecosystem collaboration framework , while introducing the achievements made in building the Token sales service system. The initiative will provide strong support for future industry partnerships and market expansion. Connecting ASEAN: Exploring Token Expansion Across Borders As Chinese enterprises accelerate their global expansion, ASEAN has emerged as one of the most dynamic overseas markets for AI applications and the Token industry , driven by its rapidly growing digital economy, open business environment, and broad range of application scenarios. This has created new opportunities for deeper China–ASEAN collaboration. To explore these opportunities, the forum featured a dedicated ASEAN Case Study Session , focusing on Token services, enterprise AI applications, and localized operations , where industry leaders shared practical insights and experiences. AHMAD FUZLI BIN FUAD, Vice President of the National Aerospace & Defence Industries (NADI) of Malaysia , shared practical experience in AI applications and Token services in the ASEAN market, drawing on local industry development. Yin Jie, General Manager of Qinghe Resonance , a subsidiary of Runjian Co., Ltd., delivered a presentation titled "Token Economy in ASEAN: Apollo11 Enterprise AI Foundation and FDE Service Deployment Guide." He showcased real-world applications of the Apollo11 Enterprise AI Foundation and FDE services across the ASEAN market. A key highlight of the conference was the signing of two major cooperation initiatives: the China–ASEAN Token Strategic Cooperation Agreement and the Token Ecosystem Cooperation Agreement . Representatives from industry, academia, and ecosystem partners came together to expand the Token industry collaboration network and promote deeper cooperation between China and ASEAN in artificial intelligence, digital industries, and related innovation ecosystems . Inclusive Innovation: Empowering Every Industry with Token As the Token service ecosystem continues to evolve, AI capabilities are rapidly expanding beyond foundation models into real-world business scenarios, enabling more enterprises and organizations to adopt artificial intelligence with lower barriers and greater efficiency . The forum showcased a wide range of Token service applications across government, manufacturing, legal services, education, and cross-border commerce, demonstrating how AI is evolving from isolated pilot projects to large-scale deployment across multiple industries. He Jun, Vice President of the AI Business Group at Runjian Co., Ltd. , introduced the company's AI FDE Service Foundation and industry application roadmap. He presented practical examples of how Token services support the development of industry-specific AI agents and the delivery of digital transformation projects, providing a solid foundation for the large-scale adoption of AI. As practical implementations continue to expand across industries, the application boundaries of Token services are becoming increasingly well defined. During the forum, representatives from the government, manufacturing, legal, education, and cross-border commerce sectors shared real-world AI deployment experiences and best practices. Advancing Industry Standards to Build a Thriving Token Ecosystem The forum concluded with a roundtable discussion themed "How the Token Economy is Reshaping AI Business Models and Expanding into ASEAN Markets." The session was moderated by Fan Congming , Executive Secretary-General of the AI Committee of the All-China Federation of Industry and Commerce and Special Advisor to the Guangxi Artificial Intelligence Industry Alliance. During the discussion, distinguished guests—including Zhao Shuangliang , Vice President of Guangxi University; Liu Wenzhong , Deputy General Manager and Chief Technology Officer of Renmin Data; Professor Lau Siu Yue , Dean of the Faculty of Information and Communication Technology at Universiti Tunku Abdul Rahman (Malaysia); Liu Jian , Deputy Director of the Energy Systems Research Center at the Energy Research Institute of China's National Development and Reform Commission; Cen Huanhui , Head of Guangxi Business at Volcano Engine; and Li Shuanglei , Deputy General Manager of Wuxiang Cloud Valley Co., Ltd.—shared insights on topics including green computing infrastructure, ecosystem collaboration, AI commercialization, and China–ASEAN cooperation . At the close of the conference, Cao Feng , Director of the Platform and Engineering Department at the Artificial Intelligence Institute of the China Academy of Information and Communications Technology (CAICT) , joined representatives from the China–ASEAN Artificial Intelligence Application Cooperation Center , Guangxi Artificial Intelligence Society , Runjian Co., Ltd. , Wuxiang Cloud Valley , Guangxi Beibu Gulf Bank , and other organizations to officially launch the Token Factory Industry Research and Standards Initiative . The initiative aims to establish the first industry standards for Token services in China, filling a critical gap in the sector while promoting standardization, high-quality development, and long-term sustainability across the Token industry. From green intelligent computing infrastructure to the Token ecosystem , and from industry applications to China–ASEAN collaboration , the forum not only showcased the latest achievements of the Wuxiang Cloud Valley Token Factory , but also reinforced its role as a strategic hub connecting AI industries across China and ASEAN. With the approval of the Nanning International Communications Gateway Bureau , Guangxi is accelerating the development of an international data corridor serving ASEAN markets. Leveraging its strategic geographic location and the opportunities created by the New International Land-Sea Trade Corridor , Runjian Co., Ltd. will continue expanding its Token capabilities globally, working closely with industry partners to unlock new opportunities for China–ASEAN AI cooperation and inject fresh momentum into the region's digital economy. Bhd. and ASEAN AI Innovation Center 2026-07-27 17:29 Source: Author: The inaugurated ceremony of Runjian (M) Sdn. Bhd. & ASEAN AI Innovation Center was grandly held on the 7th Floor, Block B3, KL Eco City, Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia on July 22, 2026. Openning Ceremony Athena Zhao Hua, Vice President of the Company & President of Overseas Business Group, Garry Zhou Guanyu, Vice President of the Company & Director of the ASEAN AI Innovation Center, together with all staff of Runjian (M) Sdn. Bhd., witnessed this significant milestone. Mr. Ong Chin Seong, Chairman of PWS Group, Dr. Cheah Kok Hoong, President of Malaysia ESG Association, Chin S oo Mau, Deputy Chairman, Pekat Group, and other core ecological partners were invited to attend the event. Participants exchanged insights on new industrial opportunities and jointly built an AI future connecting ASEAN. Group Photo Ms. Athena Zhao Hua and Mr. Garry Zhou Guanyu delivered opening addresses respectively. They stated that in just over two years, riding the momentum of booming digital economy and new energy industries in Malaysia, Runjian has achieved leapfrog growth. The company has steadily established a local operation team, expanded its business footprint from data center construction and new energy O&M management to AI application development, with service coverage extending from Kuala Lumpur to multiple states including Johor and Kedah. Speech by Zhao Hua, Vice President and President of Overseas Business Group Speech by Zhou Guanyu, Vice President and Head of ASEAN AI Innovation Center In terms of industrial collaboration, Runjian has established an operating entity via joint venture with Pekat Group. Supported by the self-developed RunDo PV Platform and AI Agent technology, the company has built robust growth momentum in the field of intelligent new energy operation and maintenance. For talent cultivation, Runjian actively fosters a local talent ecosystem. It co-founded the China (Guangxi) – Embodied Perceptive Artificial Intelligence Joint Laboratory with Universiti Tunku Abdul Rahman (UTAR), and initiated a University Computing Power Alliance together with Universiti Tunku Abdul Rahman Polytechnic. Meanwhile, Runjian has launched "Runjian Classes" and "Runjian Scholarships" at multiple Malaysian universities to systematically cultivate interdisciplinary digital talents for Malaysia and consolidate the intellectual foundation for long-term industrial development. On computing power outbound deployment, Runjian implements the collaborative development path of "R&D in Beijing, Shanghai & Guangzhou + System Integration in Guangxi + Application Rollout in ASEAN". Leveraging the Runjian Wuxiang Cloud Valley Intelligent Computing Center and adhering to the development strategy of "Token-centric, Green Computing Synergy", the company delivers cost-effective, high-security computing services for clients across the ASEAN region. Through continuous in-depth development across three pillars — industrial collaboration, talent cultivation and computing power global expansion, Runjian has gradually built a digital development infrastructure serving ASEAN. During the ceremony, all guests engaged in in-depth exchanges covering industrial integration, technology implementation and ecological co-construction. Wide-ranging cooperation consensus was reached to jointly draw the regional development blueprint, with all parties looking forward to deeper collaboration to seize opportunities brought by ASEAN’s digital economy. The official inauguration of Runjian (M) Sdn. Bhd. & ASEAN AI Innovation Center marks that Runjianhas built a core hub enabling the localized implementation of mature Chinese green computing solutions and industrial AI models in Malaysia and broader ASEAN. Standing at this new starting point, Runjian will root its operations in Malaysia and radiate to multiple ASEAN nations. Capitalizing on local talent resources and geographical advantages, the company will further deepen industrial collaboration, focus on energy, education, computing infrastructure, artificial intelligence, new energy and other sectors, deploy and popularize high-quality AI applications, and develop an international innovation ecosystem. Runjian will share digital economic opportunities with ASEAN countries, pursue win-win outcomes and embark on a new journey hand in hand. Previous : Runjian (M) Sdn. Bhd., Officially Joins MalaysiaGBC as Industry Partner 2026-08-01 12:04 Source: Author: Runjian (M) Sdn. Bhd., the Malaysian subsidiary of Runjian Co., Ltd., has officially joined the Malaysia Green Building Council (MalaysiaGBC) as an Industry Partner! This marks an important step in our deepening commitment to the Malaysian market and our green, low-carbon development strategy — as well as a key milestone in our continued expansion of green energy and smart building businesses across Southeast Asia. MalaysiaGBC is a leading industry organization dedicated to advancing green buildings, low-carbon cities, and sustainable development across Malaysia. Becoming an Industry Partner not only reflects industry recognition of Runjian's green development philosophy and comprehensive service capabilities, but also creates new opportunities for us to participate more deeply in Malaysia's green building ecosystem and strengthen local partnerships. As a digital energy and green low-carbon solution provider, Runjian Co., Ltd. is committed to empowering the energy transition through AI, digitalization, and intelligent technology. We focus on green buildings, smart energy, energy-carbon management, new energy, and digital infrastructure — delivering full-lifecycle solutions that span consulting and planning, platform construction, intelligent operations, and energy optimization. We help enterprises improve energy efficiency and support customers in Malaysia and across Southeast Asia in achieving green, low-carbon, and high-quality development. Going forward, we will take this partnership with MalaysiaGBC as an opportunity to strengthen collaboration with government agencies, industry associations, and ecosystem partners, actively contributing our digital and intelligent technology capabilities to Malaysia's — and Southeast Asia's — green and low-carbon transformation. Showcases Token-as-a-Service and AI Innovations at AIMX Singapore 2026 2026-09-08 21:11 Source: Author: AIMX Singapore 2026 has successfully concluded at Sands Expo & Convention Centre. Mr Tan Kiat How, Senior Minister of State, Ministry of Digital Development and Information, visited Runjian Co., Ltd.’s booth. As an official Platinum Partner of the event, Runjian focused firmly on Token overseas expansion, showcasing its Token-as-a-Service ecosystem layout across the ASEAN region under the theme “Token as a Service: Powering a Smarter ASEAN”. At the exhibition, Runjian displayed a full lineup of innovative technological solutions covering multiple industry scenarios, including Wuxiang Cloud Valley Token Factory, Apollo 11 CEL enterprise platform, Lawer — ASEAN Legal AI Agent, Hanmate — Online Chinese Learning Platform, and iRun Renewable Energy Platform. The diversified product matrix fully demonstrates Runjian’s robust technical strength and practical application capabilities in core fields such as computing power service, green energy management, intelligent education, enterprise intelligent transformation and government digital governance. The innovative Token-driven technology system attracted extensive attention from global industry clients, developers and ecological partners, who conducted in-depth exchanges on ASEAN localized digital cooperation.
